item.title: Legacy of Precision and Integration in Plastic Injection Molding
item.description:
Legacy of Precision and Integration in Plastic Injection Molding
#

Over 36 Years of Expertise in Taiwan
#

Founded in 1986 as Hsing Chia Enterprise, Chia Kuan has steadily built a reputation for excellence in the field of plastic injection molding. In 1996, the company expanded its capital and adopted the name Chia Kuan Co., Ltd., marking a new chapter in its journey. With more than three decades of dedicated experience, Chia Kuan has refined its production processes to deliver products that meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.

item.title: Legacy and Commitment in Precision Plastic Manufacturing
item.description:
Legacy and Commitment in Precision Plastic Manufacturing
#

Over 36 Years of Expertise in Taiwan
#

Founded in 1986 as Hsing Chia Enterprise, Chia Kuan has evolved over more than three decades into a trusted name in plastic injection molding and mold development. In 1996, the company expanded its capital and adopted the name Chia Kuan Co., Ltd., building on a foundation of meticulous production processes and a steadfast commitment to delivering defect-free products. Our experience and attention to detail ensure stable quality and smooth project execution for every client.

item.title: Key Principles and Process of Plastic Injection Molding
item.description:
Key Principles and Process of Plastic Injection Molding
#

Plastic materials have become integral to contemporary living, with approximately 60% of daily necessities made from plastic. Among the various manufacturing methods, plastic injection molding stands out as a fundamental industrial technique, playing a pivotal role in the production of countless plastic products.
